map.把收入、租金与资料核对项放在一张清单里：输出租金收入比和负担能力参考，不自动评级: Put income, rent and document checks into one list: output the rent-to-income ratio and an affordability reference, with no automated grade, deposit advice or rejection.
map.输入租客收入、租金与资料核对项，输出租金收入比、负担能力参考和 6 项资料清单；: Enter tenant income, rent and document checks to get the rent-to-income ratio, an affordability reference and a 6-item document checklist; no automated grade, deposit advice or rejection, and personal data stays local.
map.填写月收入（必填，大于 0）与月租金（可为 0）。: Enter monthly income (required, greater than 0) and monthly rent (0 is allowed).
map.可选填写工作年限与信用分（信用分 350–950，需注明来源）；留空也能生成。: Optionally enter work years and credit score (350–950, source must be stated); both may be left blank.
map.勾选已实际核实的资料项：身份证明、收入/银行流水、工作证明、征信报告、前任房东评: Tick the items actually verified: identity, income/bank statements, employment proof, credit report, previous landlord reference and guarantor documents.
map.读取租金收入比、月收入减租金余额与核对进度，结合当地法律和面谈自行判断。: Read the rent-to-income ratio, income minus rent and checklist progress, then judge with local law and an interview.
map.出租前统一核对申请人的可验证资料，避免只凭印象决定。: Before renting, verify applicants with a consistent, evidence-based checklist instead of relying on impressions.
map.多名申请人并排比较时，只比较可核实事实与负担能力。: When comparing applicants, compare only verifiable facts and affordability.
map.把结果作为面谈提纲：哪些资料待补、租金占收入是否偏高。: Use the result as an interview outline: which documents are missing and whether rent takes too much income.
map.租金收入比 = 4 000 ÷ 12 000 = 33.3%，月收入减租金 =: Rent-to-income ratio = 4,000 ÷ 12,000 = 33.3%; income minus rent = 8,000 CNY. With only identity and income statements ticked, progress is 2/6. The page no longer outputs A/B/C/D grades, deposit months or rejection advice, and does not score by age.
map.年龄不参与计算；不得基于年龄、性别、地域等无关因素区别对待；信用分须注明来源并核: Age is not used; do not treat applicants differently based on age, gender, region or other irrelevant factors; state the credit-score source and check the original report; personal data is processed only in this browser.
map.为什么不再给等级和押金建议？: Why are grades and deposit advice gone?
map.固定权重评分与拒租结论缺乏可验证依据，也容易引入歧视；改为资料清单与负担能力参考: Fixed-weight scores and rejection conclusions lack verifiable evidence and can introduce discrimination; the tool now shows a document checklist and affordability reference for the landlord to judge.
map.不参与，页面已移除年龄评分。: No; age scoring has been removed from the page.
map.信用分从哪里来？: Where does the credit score come from?
map.工具不提供信用分；填写时需注明来源并核对报告原件，留空也可正常生成。: The tool does not provide a credit score; if entered, state its source and check the original report. It can also be left blank.
